literature_notes: CATSPERQ (TMEM249) is a two-TM-pass protein with both termini intracellular (N-term 1–60, C-term 105–235) and only a 10-residue extracellular loop (79–88). L1 reports a full-length CATSPERθ-Flag construct used for co-IP in 293T cells; the '-Flag' suffix convention places the tag at the C-terminus (residue 235), which is intracellular — this is recorded in other_positions. L2 reports a two-TM-domain-deleted construct (Cyto-CSθ-Flag), which is not a full-length membrane-anchored protein and is therefore disqualified. No ledger line reports any tag insertion on the extracellular face or in the extracellular loop (79–88). Zero surface tag sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: CATSPERθ-Flag (full-length) used for co-IP in 293T cells; '-Flag' suffix places tag at C-terminus (residue 235), which is intracellular (topology 105–235); no extracellular surface tag position is stated or derivable.
